layerAlign.centerTitle: Move the selected layer to the center of the scene (⇧⌘K)
layerAlign.resetTitle: Reset the selected layer's scale / rotation (⇧⌘U)
layerAlign.noSelection: Select a layer in the tree or on the canvas first
layerAlign.hasParent: “{name}” has a parent layer, so its position is relative to it; centering only applies to top-level layers
layerAlign.noOrtho: This scene has no orthographic size (perhaps a perspective camera), so its center can't be computed
